Definition
[Disk class and least area] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0259 1. ch33:33.22\group Minimal disks

Given a boundary torus of $\mathcal M_A(t)$, let $\mathfrak T_A(t)$ be the smooth maps $f:D^2\to \mathcal M\setminus \mathcal M_A(t)$ whose boundary lies in that torus and represents a nontrivial element of its fundamental group. Define \[ A_{\mathfrak T_A}(t)=\inf _{f\in \mathfrak T_A(t)} \operatorname {Area}_{g(t)}f(D^2). \]
